title: Release day keeps saved names that contain the word Catalog
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · access to the test environment before the Part Lifecycle build is deployed (Setup steps 1 and 2) · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: created before the deployment: a custom role [Role-C] named e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog Clerk" and a part [PN-C] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CATWORD-01) with the description "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog rack".

Setup

  1. Before the deployment, on the earlier build, sign in as [User-A]: Settings → Roles & Permissions → Create custom role → Skip → Role name "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog Clerk" → tick any one permission → Create. [Role-C] = this role.
  2. Still before the deployment: Parts → Catalog → New Catalog Part with Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CATWORD-01 and Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog rack", then Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part picking that catalog part, Quantity 1, Save. [PN-C] = that part number.
  3. If steps 1 and 2 could not be done before the deployment, this case cannot be run: write "no pre-deployment data, not checked" in the result comment.
  4. Check the setup worked: after the deployment, [Role-C] and [PN-C] still exist (search for them).
custom_steps:
1. Sign in on the Part Lifecycle build as [User-A].
  2. Pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  3. In the left menu open Settings, then Roles & Permissions.
  4. Find [Role-C] in the list and read its name.
  5. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  6. Type [PN-C] in the Search box.
  7. Read the description of [PN-C].
  8. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  9. Type [PN-C] in the Search box.
  10. Read the entry's description.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The role is still named "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog Clerk", word for word.
  • Step 7: The part's description is still "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog rack".
  • Step 10: The Part Library entry's description is still "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog rack": saved data was not renamed; only the screen's own words changed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S12-N3, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas (no board shows this screen).
